name: Tovino Thomas
bio: Tovino Thomas is an Indian film actor active in Malayalam films. He made his acting debut in 2012 with the Malayalam film Prabhuvinte Makkal. Tovino is recognized for the wide range of characters he had portrayed in the Malayalam film industry which includes protagonists, strong crucial characters and negative roles.
